SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members_joined
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date = '2026-10-03'

WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_joined
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1
  AND join_date = '2026-10-03'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_members,
    MIN(join_date) AS earliest_join_date,
    MAX(join_date) AS latest_join_date
FROM dim_member

SELECT calendar_date, day_name, is_trading_day, is_public_holiday, holiday_name
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2026-10-03'
